lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-luminance circular clusters are arranged in three distinct vertical columns posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a semi-regular grid across the lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating grid-like anchor nodes along the visible mid-section of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance transition with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and a shadow gradient on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of small, high-frequency luminance spots is visible across the dorsal and lateral surfaces of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, sparser blobs on the primary flank.
